ARABIC LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Phonological Awareness: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Fluency.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

6. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

7. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
